solver.kind: blind AI solver (separate agent, answer-free packet, rubric v2)

flags: minor: key D is the longest choice and the only one with two parts (describe + weigh), a mild length tell
R010-01.notes: Passage presents the decoy effect, then paragraphs 4-5 question how far it holds outside the lab. A is only the opening detail, B goes beyond the passage (no recommendation is made), and C reverses paragraph 3.

R010-02.notes: Para 2: 'Faced with a comparison that is easy to make, people lean toward the option that wins it.' C is contradicted ('tells them nothing new'). B and D are unsupported.

R010-03.notes: The parenthetical explains why print-only is clearly worse than print-and-online (more for the same price). D is false: online-only is cheapest.

R010-04.notes: Near-paraphrase of 'should not change which of the remaining options is preferred.' A describes what actually happened (the trap), and D is the alternative view.

R010-05.notes: 'Troubling for a model' means it poses a problem for the model. 'Distressing' is the tempting emotional sense.

R010-06.notes: Direct paraphrase of para 4, sentence 2. C reverses the lab point.

flags: minor: distractors B, C and D are all extreme ('main force', 'ever... at all', 'sure'), so only A is moderately worded, which is a test-wise tell
R010-07.notes: Last sentence: 'a question the research has not yet settled.'

R010-08.notes: The skeptics say the effect is reliable mainly in simple lab tasks. Real-world shoppers with many attributes who ignore decoys supports them. A is consistent with their view but does not support the overstated-importance claim, and B undercuts them. C is irrelevant.

R010-09.notes: 'Even so, businesses appear to have taken the lesson to heart.' B is wrong because the question is explicitly unsettled. C overstates with 'only', and D is unsupported.

flags: minor: B is absolute ('any living animal at all') and is easily eliminated
R010-10.notes: The cells were immune cells that accumulated iron 'for unrelated reasons', so they were not magnetic sensors.
